packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates are automerged for every manager (bundler, npm, gradle, gradle-wrapper). Majors still get a manual review.
GitHub Actions are automerged for every update type, majors included.
Android Studio caps the AGP version it can open a project with, so an AGP bump has to land together with an IDE upgrade. Renovate still opens the PR; a human merges it once Studio is ready.
